canonical_status.summary: Conductor roadmap tracks are complete, archived, or actively tracked. The full product vision remains a future-state program for Rust ownership, external submission, and registry-hygiene work, while documentation cutover status is now evidence-backed by passing Astro/Starlight build and check results.
canonical_status.claim_policy: Do not claim full Rust ownership, external submission acceptance, or production DocSearch readiness unless the corresponding evidence artifact or external gate is complete.

reviewed_sources.claim: Project status identifies Astro/Starlight as the active documentation stack and labels Sphinx as archival/redirect-reference material.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep product status aligned with Starlight validation evidence and describe Sphinx only as archival or compatibility material.

reviewed_sources.claim: The documentation section identifies Astro/Starlight as active and Sphinx as legacy archival/redirect-reference material; build readiness is validated by passing pnpm build and pnpm check evidence.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep tech-stack status aligned with Starlight validation evidence and avoid describing Sphinx as the active docs stack.

reviewed_sources.claim: Route, link, build, and Astro check validation pass; the prior local starlight-polyglot handler bundle blocker is resolved, and starlight-versions is enabled after the 0.9.0 update. Production DocSearch remains an explicit external credential gate.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep residual DocSearch credentials explicit until deployment credentials are available.

reviewed_sources.claim: Original roadmap stages, deferred follow-on tracks, and audit gap tracks are completed and archived.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep this true for the previous roadmap while adding the new future-state follow-on tracks to the coverage map.

reviewed_sources.claim: The core is not fully Rust-owned, and full Rust ownership must not be claimed until every canonical operation, model family, and stable payload shape is native or explicitly promoted elsewhere.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Link operation and payload gaps to the new Rust-native completion tracks.

reviewed_sources.claim: CRAN, Spack, EasyBuild, HPSF, and E4S remain pending, deferred, or blocked.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep readiness distinct from accepted submission status and close or reclassify blockers in the external submission blocker track.

reviewed_sources.claim: HPSF and E4S remain blocked on governance and accelerator-review channels.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Preserve blocker evidence until external review contacts, submission receipts, or explicit deferral decisions exist.

reviewed_sources.claim: The Astro/Starlight mirror lists deferred and blocked registry targets.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep the Astro/Starlight mirror aligned with the canonical registry receipt evidence.

reviewed_sources.claim: New granular follow-on tracks are registered for roadmap truth, Rust operation completion, Rust payload and model coverage, Starlight cutover, external submission blocker closure, and Conductor registry hygiene.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Maintain each unresolved roadmap-level gap as an active Conductor track until implementation and review are complete.

future_state_tracks.scope: Canonical product vision and roadmap status truth.
Astro/Starlight cutover and legacy Sphinx cleanup.
External submission blockers, receipts, and explicit deferrals.
